message: Hi, I'm a student with a app development certification background. My overall academic average is 73.6% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in parallel computing and Business process analyst. I want to become a Database Administrator. My family can afford at most about USD 800 per year. I live in Chennai. I cannot leave my city. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.
explanation:
This MSc Cloud Computing program is located in Chennai and requires a CS background, matching your profile. It offers relevant skills for database administration and has a decent starting salary, which aligns with your priority of job placement.

While MDes Interaction Design is not directly related to databases or parallel computing, it meets all your constraints: it's in Chennai, affordable (USD 450), and has a good placement rate. It should be considered if job prospects are the absolute top priority.
